answer: Ration admission by a per-epoch lottery with sunk fees. Each epoch the protocol draws 40 slots from the applicant delta via the beacon seed; entry costs 10 POA, kept by the pool whether or not the ticket is drawn. An attacker buying M identities must re-enter every epoch, so expected cost is 10 per ticket times crowd density: linear per identity, superlinear once its bulk thickens the pool. Slots reset each epoch, so nothing is pre-farmable or batch-buyable; a jade hoard pays nothing upfront. Honest agents pay 10 in expectation; the registry stays a garden gated by draws.
